evidence.mechanism: historical row wording is encoded as JSON object keys; the schema-diagnostic error printed those keys while attempting to discover text-bearing fields

decision.reason: The higher frozen Candidate v0.4 data contract requires fresh sealed development plus exact/near-duplicate exclusion, but does not require generator blindness. A replacement pre-score protocol may proceed if it does not relax any contamination threshold or runtime gate and explicitly records that freshness is established by deterministic generation plus post-generation exclusion rather than blind authoring.
